knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Verbal requests on site do not change the booking. Recording the request and getting written confirmation protects the worker, the customer and the business.
Replacing a fuse inside an electrical housing is electrical work outside this course. The other options are external or accessible cleaning tasks in the booking scope.
Resetting a tripped thermostat or opening a housing is excluded. The correct action is to leave it, record it and refer it.
The booking or work order sets the authority, including the included and excluded tasks.
Internal work carries risks and may need a licence the worker does not hold. Price, timing and supervisor attendance are not the reason.

practicalCriteria: Identifies in-scope and excluded tasks from the booking before touching the equipment
Stops and records an out-of-scope request without starting that work
Explains the refusal to the site contact in plain words without promising a repair
Reports the refusal or referral to the supervisor at the end of the job
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate: an assessor observes the practical criteria and records the result. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not grant any licence or authority.
evidenceRequired: Booking or work order with the scope recorded
Record of each refused request with time and name
stopWorkCriteria: Any request to open, reset or change an internal or electrical part
Any verbal change of scope without written confirmation
